figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Transformation of (6Z)-GGPP with SiCotB2. (A) Conversion of GGPP with SiCotB2 into 30. (B) Cyclization mechanism from (6Z)-
GGPP to 31−34 by SiCotB2. Computational data (wB97M-V/Def2-TZVPPD//B97D3/6-31G(d,p), 298 K) are shown in boxes (blue: Gibbs ener-
gies, ‡ denotes free energies of transition states, both relative to A6 set to 0.0 kcal/mol; black: Gibbs reaction barriers; red: free reaction energies; all
in kcal/mol; imaginary frequencies of transition states are given in cm−1). Blue asterisks indicate minor conformational changes between the product
of one computed step and the starting structure of the next step. (C) Conversion of GGPP into 35 and 36 by CgDS.
